verdict.rationale: treg is a tool catalog: you can search by capability rather than vendor (`GET /catalog/search?q=backlinks`) across 3,800+ catalogued provider endpoints. You can compare platforms side by side on measured success rate, speed and price, and every endpoint lists its price, parameters and an example response, so you can browse before wiring anything in. The probe confirms llms.txt bills it as "the tool catalog for your agent", but the catalog covers provider API endpoints rather than third-party MCP servers. Missing for 10: cataloguing of MCP servers specifically, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the search and browse experience.
